texte.Incidence dans deux États membres ou plu: Impact in two or more Member States
texte.Informations à l'attention des parties i: Information for the interested parties of the AI systems
texte.Inscrire la date au registre d'informati: Entering the date in the register of information of article #(#): it changes the supervision regime for that contract.
texte.Inspections sur place et contrôles à dis: On-site inspections and ex post remote checks
On-site inspections and remote checks, including random checks
texte.Institution de retraite professionnelle: An institution for occupational retirement provision
texte.Intermédiaire d'assurance, de réassuranc: An insurance, reinsurance or ancillary insurance intermediary
texte.Interruption de service supérieure à # h: Service interruption longer than # hours for ICT services supporting critical or important functions
texte.Intégration de la sécurité numérique dan: Embedding digital security in human resources management
texte.Intérêts de retard de l'article # du règ: Default interest under article # of Regulation (EU, Euratom) #/#.
texte.L'absence de solutions de substitution r: The absence of real alternatives — a limited number of players, market share, proprietary technology — and the difficulty of migrating data and workloads elsewhere, in cost, in time and in added risk.
The absence of real alternatives, even partial ones — a limited number of players, market share, technical complexity, proprietary technology, the organisation's own characteristics.
texte.L'abstention est une intervention : la p: Abstaining is an intervention: the designated person must be able to set an output aside without using it, and that refusal is recorded as an oversight event.
texte.L'acceptation d'un risque résiduel se dé: The acceptance of a residual risk is decided at the level with the power to accept it, and it is recorded: otherwise it did not happen.
texte.L'accepter en l'état. Légitime SI le niv: Accepting it as it stands. Legitimate IF the level meets the acceptance criteria established, and if the owner has written and dated it.
The implementing act is not in the corpus. This module therefore shows no figure for the deadline: doing so would present as sourced a figure that is not.
texte.L'acte délégué C(#) # ne dit pas express: Delegated act C(#) # does not say expressly whether the two shares of sub-criterion # and sub-criterion # must be reached within THE SAME category of financial entities, as article #(#) requires for sub-criteria # and #. The module computes BOTH readings and flags where they diverge, rather than picking one in silence.
The action is in place for this system.
texte.L'action ne s'applique pas à ce système: The action does not apply to this system — and you must be able to say why.
texte.L'agent dispose de plus d'outils, de dro: The agent has more tools, more rights or more latitude than its task calls for.
texte.L'ajout d'observations par la personne d: Letting the designated person add observations is regularly forgotten: what they knew of the environment at the time of the output is in no machine log.
texte.L'alinéa (h) de l'article #(#), et l'art: Subparagraph (h) of article #(#), and article #. This is the chapter that neither ISO standard covers.
texte.L'alinéa (i) de l'article #(#). Sept exi: Subparagraph (i) of article #(#). Seven requirements in that one clause — the heaviest in the standard.
texte.L'alinéa (m) de l'article #(#) ne demand: Subparagraph (m) of article #(#) does not ask for a name: it asks for a responsibility that carries weight.
texte.L'altération des informations nécessaire: The alteration of the information needed for the entity's activities or services
texte.L'analyse de risque elle-même : gouverna: The risk analysis itself: governance under the chief executive, every system covered, residual risks accepted, a dated and assigned action plan, a three-yearly review.
texte.L'analyse de risque y cesse d'être une c: Risk analysis there stops being one box out of ten and becomes four verifiable requirements.
texte.L'annexe A l'effleure : elle demande d'e: Annex A only brushes against it: it asks for a framework, not for the technical countermeasure to be built.
texte.L'annexe A porte des mesures qui traiten: Annex A carries controls that address this risk head-on.
texte.L'annexe G — les mesures que la surcharg: Annex G — the controls the industrial overlay reworks, family by family — and the reasons it gives for reworking them.
Annex III is a list of purposes. With no purpose written down, there is nothing to compare it against.
texte.L'annexe ZA la rattache à l'article #(#): Annex ZA links it to article #(#): this is the document a notified body asks for first, and per system, not per company.
texte.L'annexe ZA le dit sous réserve : l'alin: Annex ZA says so with a reservation: subparagraph (g) is covered only IF the risk management system complies with article #.
texte.L'annexe ZA porte une ligne « Non couver: Annex ZA carries a « Not covered » row — article #(#). A hundred per cent here therefore does not mean article # is met.
texte.L'approche choisie ouvre la charge du #,: The approach chosen opens the burden of #, and at least one of the three pieces is missing.
texte.L'approche est choisie et sa charge de p: The approach is chosen and its burden of proof is honoured.
texte.L'approche est-elle ACTIVE — collecte or: Is the approach ACTIVE — organised collection, and not waiting for a complaint?
texte.L'appréciation des risques de l'article: The risk assessment of clause # governs the statement of applicability that follows — and it is carried out WITHIN a written scope.
texte.L'architecture qui isole une sortie non: The architecture that isolates an unreviewed output, the evidence that it works, what makes the two reviewers independent, the corresponding tests, and what the deployer can configure
texte.L'article # alinéa par alinéa, et le par: Article # subparagraph by subparagraph, and the clause of the standard that covers it.
texte.L'article # porte l'approbation des mesu: Article # carries the approval of the article # measures by the management bodies; it follows the fate of the article it governs. No article names it, however.
texte.L'article # §# définit le système d'IA p: Article #(#) defines an AI system by its ability to infer. A hand-written rules engine does not fall within the Regulation, and the type is what says so.
texte.L'article #, paragraphe #, fait de la do: Article #(#) makes the documentation the evidence of compliance.
texte.L'article #, paragraphe #, le nomme expr: Article #(#) names it expressly: « including those relating to the oversight and enforcement provided for in Chapter VII ».
texte.L'article #, paragraphe #, point a), fix: Article #(#)(a) sets the equivalence against article #(#) and (#): that is the provision the sectoral act replaces.
texte.L'article #, paragraphe #, point b), fix: Article #(#)(b) sets the equivalence against article #(#) to (#).
texte.L'article #, qui dit ce qu'un acte secto: Article #, which says what a sectoral act carves out, and Annex I, which says which financial types are listed in it.
texte.L'article #, qui remplace les dix mesure: Article #, which replaces the Directive's ten measures with four families and refers to the framework; article #, which shifts the burden of proof; article #, which sets the act aside in favour of an equivalent sectoral act.
texte.L'article #, §#, de l'annexe à la recomm: Article #(#) of the Annex to Recommendation #/#/EC — which excludes from SME status an enterprise # % or more owned by a public body — does not apply for the purposes of NIS #.
texte.L'article #er, paragraphe #, de DORA SUP: Article #(#) of DORA ASSUMES that identification: it is the condition of the carve-out, not its subject.
texte.L'article #er, paragraphe #, qui fait de: Article #(#), which makes DORA a sectoral legal act, and recital #, which calls it lex specialis.
texte.L'article invoqué n'appartient pas à la: The article relied on is not in the closed list of articles that may be relied on.
texte.L'article invoqué ne peut pas soutenir l: The article relied on cannot support the class proposed.
texte.L'atteinte aux personnes et aux biens, d: Harm to people and property, distinct from information security.
texte.L'auditeur recoupe le statut déclaré de: The auditor cross-checks the declared status of each selected control against what they find: records, configurations, interviews.
texte.L'auditeur vérifie que le système EXISTE: The auditor checks that the system EXISTS on paper: scope, policy, risk assessment AND risk treatment, statement of applicability, internal audit plan.
texte.L'effet systémique sur la stabilité, la: The systemic effect on the stability, continuity or quality of the provision of financial services if the provider were to suffer a large-scale operational failure.
texte.L'efficacité se mesure dans VOS conditio: Effectiveness is measured in YOUR conditions: the same alert threshold does not produce the same load at two different deployers.
texte.L'enregistrement du rejet relève de la p: Recording the rejection comes under prEN #-#: without it, there is no way to demonstrate later that the output did not act.
texte.L'entité est dans le champ de DORA, mais: The entity falls within DORA's scope, but it is not identified as an essential or important entity. Article # has no object; DORA applies in its own right.
texte.L'entité est exclue par l'article #, par: The entity is excluded by article #(#). A regulation that does not apply cannot be the sectoral act that carves out the Directive.
texte.L'entité est une entité financière dans: The entity is a financial entity within DORA's scope and identified as essential or important: article #(#) applies, and article # of the Directive takes effect.
texte.L'entité n'est pas qualifiée : on ne sai: The entity is not qualified: it is not known whether the regime is that of essential or of important entities.
texte.L'entité n'est pas une entité financière: The entity is not a financial entity within the meaning of article #(#): article #(#) does not cover it. NIS # remains enforceable against it in full, and DORA reaches it under Chapter V.
texte.L'entité qui met en œuvre les exigences: An entity that implements the framework's requirements may rely on them with ANSSI during an inspection to demonstrate that the objectives are met.
texte.L'entité relève de l'une des cinq catégo: The entity falls within one of the five categories of article #(#).
texte.L'entité valide l'analyse, ACCEPTE expli: The entity approves the analysis, explicitly ACCEPTS the residual risks, and implements the action plan. The plan provides at least, for each action, a reasonable deadline and an owner.
texte.L'exclusion et sa justification doivent: The exclusion and its justification must appear explicitly in the list of systems. There is no such thing as a tacit exclusion.
texte.L'exigence ne s'applique pas à ce systèm: The requirement does not apply to this system — and you must be able to say why.
texte.L'exigence peut être satisfaite par une: The requirement can be satisfied by an analysis per activity or per service, provided it covers ALL the systems that carry it. It rests on five inputs: the information security policy and the sector's own features, command of the ecosystem, command of the information system, the compliance-led approach, and the audits. The EBIOS RM method may be used.
texte.L'exploitation et la surveillance du sys: Are the operation and the monitoring of the system in service organised?
texte.L'horloge part de la PRISE DE CONNAISSAN: The clock starts from BECOMING AWARE of the significant incident, not from its resolution.
texte.L'identification comme entité essentiell: Identification as an essential or important entity, and entry on the list the Member State draws up.
texte.L'incidence sur la disponibilité, l'auth: The impact on availability, authenticity, integrity or confidentiality harms or will harm the operational objectives or the meeting of regulatory requirements
texte.L'incident a touché des services TIC ou: The incident has affected ICT services or network and information systems supporting critical or important functions, or financial services subject to authorisation.
texte.L'indexation se fait avec les droits de: Indexing runs with the rights of whoever indexes, searching with those of whoever asks — and almost nobody reconciles the two.
texte.L'indice consolidé est une moyenne d'axe: The consolidated index is an average of axes: it does not replace reading axis by axis.
texte.L'intensité de l'incidence d'une interru: How severely an interruption of the provider's services would affect the activities of the financial entities retained at step #, and the number of entities concerned.
texte.L'interdépendance entre les EISm ou autr: The interdependence between the G-SIIs or O-SIIs and the other financial entities retained at step #, in particular where those institutions provide financial infrastructure services to other financial entities.
texte.L'interface permet-elle une inspection d: Does the interface allow detailed inspection — zoom, overview, side-by-side or toggled display of the probe and the reference — and does it flag poor image quality and scores below the thresholds declared in the instructions?
texte.L'inventaire des systèmes d'IA : leur fi: The inventory of AI systems: their purpose, their department, their classification, and the eight cost and footprint fields.
texte.L'invite système, et ce qu'elle contient: The system prompt, and what it contains — business rules, keys, tool names, guardrails — ends up in the user's hands.
texte.L'objectif est tenu, et l'entité peut le: The objective is met, and the entity can show it.
texte.L'obligation porte sur les ACTIVITÉS, pa: The obligation bears on the ACTIVITIES, not on the systems: carrying on serving, not just restarting a machine.
texte.L'option est propre à chaque État membre: The option belongs to each Member State and must be checked with the national authority. It is not presumed to have been exercised.
texte.L'une des conditions de l'article #, poi: One of the conditions in article #, points (a) to (d), is met
texte.L'écart le plus fréquent : la supervisio: The commonest gap: oversight is given to whoever is available, not to the profile declared.
texte.L'écran dit-il ce que le système sait et: Does the screen say what the system can and cannot do, and does it relate what it does TO the risk scenarios you have identified — not to general curves?
texte.L'équipe d'examen conjoint : qui supervi: The joint examination team: who actually oversees, with what tasks and under whose coordination.
texte.L'équipe d'examen conjoint exerce les ac: The joint examination team carries out the oversight activities, under the coordination of the lead overseer's coordinator.
texte.L'équivalence est acquise si les mesures: Equivalence is established if the risk-management measures are at least as good as those of article #(#) and (#), or if the sectoral act gives the CSIRTs, the competent authorities or the single points of contact immediate access to the notifications and sets reporting requirements at least equivalent to article #(#) to (#).
texte.L'étape # dépend d'une lecture que le te: Step # depends on a reading the text does not settle
texte.L'étape # est franchie — l'étape # s'app: Step # is cleared — step # is assessed
texte.L'état du système ne se résume pas à « e: The state of the system is not just « running »: active, inactive, degraded and safe do not call for the same reaction.
texte.L'étendue du contrôle exercé sur chaque: Is the extent of the control exercised over each link determined by what that link carries?
texte.LES CRITÈRES DE DÉSIGNATION, CHIFFRÉS :: THE DESIGNATION CRITERIA, IN FIGURES: two steps, four threshold sub-criteria, and the # % bar.
texte.La Commission publie des lignes directri: The Commission publishes guidelines clarifying the application of paragraphs # and #, and reviews them.
texte.La PSSI et les spécificités sectorielles: The information security policy and the sector's own features
texte.La base vectorielle d'un RAG rend des fr: A RAG's vector store returns fragments the requester had no right to read, or ingests poisoned fragments.
texte.La catégorie ne s'applique pas — et il f: The category does not apply — and you must be able to say why.
texte.La certification porte sur le système de: The certification covers the management system, not each AI system.
texte.La chaîne d'approvisionnement du système: Is the AI system's supply chain under control?
texte.La chaîne de notification : alerte préco: The reporting chain: early warning, notification, final report.
texte.La chaîne de notification et ses délais: The reporting chain and its deadlines in hours, the threat-led penetration testing, and the register of information of article #(#) are not in this figure. A hundred per cent here does not mean DORA is met.
texte.La chaîne se répète à blanc, elle ne se: The chain is rehearsed, not ticked. The deadlines run in hours, and the first one to fall due governs.
texte.La classe commande la procédure d'évalua: The class governs the assessment procedure, and therefore the budget.
texte.La classe est DÉCLARÉE, jamais devinée d: The class is DECLARED, never guessed from the product's name.
texte.La classe proposée n'appartient pas au v: The class proposed is not in the register's vocabulary.
texte.La classification d'un système au sens d: A system's classification within the meaning of the Regulation: its risk level, the article it rests on, and the obligations that follow.
texte.La classification des incidents contre l: The classification of incidents against the numerical thresholds that decide on notification — clients affected, duration, Member States concerned, costs.
texte.La collecte est massive, la relecture ne: The collection is massive, the review is not, and the effect only shows in use.
texte.La communication avec les autorités, les: Is communication with the authorities, the notified bodies and the deployers organised and kept up?
Communication with the authorities, the notified bodies, the other operators, the clients and the interested parties.
